This reads one existing source HDF and evaluates scalar windows from its original component inventories and frozen temperatures. No history factory, replay loader or previous source integration is rerun.

The emitted-number and energy partition tests are conditional on the window estimated numerical envelopes and the stated original-source quadrature/residual/rounding allowance. They are not certified interval bounds or experimental errors.

Every conditioned component retains its original interval, pool/exact state, current patch, temperature, physical area, local time law and origin. Width redistribution changes only launch x; no averaged temperature or new state yield is introduced.

The number kernels are arbitrary fixed functions of SOURCE gate, exact state and current patch, constant within each selected window. The finite aperture assumes a uniform launch density inside each width patch and is manufactured, not recovered optics.

Individually represented fields and partition closure do not accept a conservative host transaction. Signed residuals are retained; no residual repair, packet allocation, random sampling, gap transport, chemistry, radiation or physical spectrum is provided.
windowed_source_controls.spatial_summary_rule: Integrated parent and J values use actual patch area once. Areal summaries are corresponding physical extensive values divided by actual total face area, never unweighted sums of patch densities.
